values.note: 30-amp electric/water/sewer sites $30 a night, 50-amp $35 (tent sites $20); rates are per family, and each additional family on a site pays too. On-site septic removal $20. Cash or check only.

fees.source: https://townofowego.com/departments/parks_recreation.php (Camping Rates: '30 amp Electric/Water/Sewer Sites - $30 per night. 50 amp Electric/Water/Sewer Sites - $35 per night Tent Sites - $20 per night On-site Septic Removal - $20 Camping rates are per family'; page carries the 2026 concert schedule), read 2026-10-21

values.note: No reservations; first come, first served. Cash or check, no credit cards.

note: Town of Owego municipal park on the Susquehanna River. Boat launch, dog park. Carry in, carry out: the town parks have no trash cans. Apr-Oct. --Claude
